title: Cross-DODAG DAO propagation via backbone
description: Gateways propagate reachable destinations across the backbone so any BR can forward to any node in the merged mesh. Already spec'd in GCP-5.3. Implementation: each BR maintains a backbone route table (destination IID → owning BR). Updates propagated via CoAP Observe on /.well-known/lichen-gw/routes. Spec: 08-gateway-coordination.md GCP-5.3. Rust and C BR implementations.
